title: Fresh sessions instead of context drift

message.text:
**Most agents need nothing beyond a fresh start: CLAUDE.md plus their role's skill. Only the four long-lived roles also read a checkpoint line, and Servex recycles them by itself.**

```
role                         recycle when              a fresh session reads
minion · clarity · fixer     each job (stops after)    CLAUDE.md + skill + its brief
card assistant               40k tokens                + the card's page.jsonl (already)
task mastermind · manager    150k, or at landing       + task.jsonl (steps, log) + requirements.md
mastermind-servex            150k, or each day         + its day task's last summary line
master assistant             each day (already)        + its own page
page assistant (planned)     a New session forks the baseline, which never grows
```

- [ ] **Servex triggers it, not the agent.** ai2-lead reached 321k and I reached 237k, because an agent doesn't notice its own size. Servex already sees each agent's context in list_agents. Between turns, past the threshold, it asks for one checkpoint line, then restarts the agent on the same id with its role prompt plus "resume from <checkpoint>".
- [ ] **This goes into the existing brief:** todo.md, Module agents, piece 1 (the context rule). Use these per-role thresholds in place of one flat 40%.
- CLAUDE.md alone is enough for every one-job role. Long-lived roles also need their open items, and the checkpoint line carries them.
